The 0.3 ATR-gated reversal shadow filter only triggers on significant upper/lower wicks relative to body size, capturing true rejection levels while ignoring noise. This mechanism exploits cj's tendency for sharp intraday reversals at technical extremes.
symbol_fit: Why cj: dried chili peppers have seasonally concentrated supply, weather sensitivity, and lower liquidity than major grains, making price action more prone to speculative whip-saws. Reversal signals with strict wick/ATR gating (0.3) filter agricultural futures noise better than standard momentum.
